dataflow.finding: selector 0 copies the caller buffer to both globals 0x180580818 and 0x180580838; selector 1 copies down only; other nonzero selectors copy up only
IRQ 0x0002 takes the event raw-base region and calls 0x180029314; the OEM log identifies this as obtaining the fdt-up base while in fdt-down mode
validates the raw table, derives six encoded words using raw_word/2 plus context offset (or fallback 0x15), applies touchflag/mode-dependent replacement, and commits to 0x180580838
the Fdt-up branch builds 0a || variant and copies the configured table length directly from 0x180580838 into the command body
IRQ 0x0200 is dispatched as fdt-up and the normal branch derives/commits the down table at 0x180580818; a mode-dependent branch can instead refresh up
the Fdt-down branch copies the current 0x180580818 table and appends a timestamp

model_consequence: tables are IRQ-owned generation-tagged inputs; a fixed up/down table reused across cycles is rejected
